title: S11T05 - Implement policy-aware git diagnostics and remediation hints
description: Change the git check and user-facing command output so agents can tell what is actually wrong and what action is expected.
acceptanceCriteria: prime, sync status, sync refresh, and doctor expose structured git findings with severity and category.
Protected main, dirty collaboration paths, and untracked generated directories each produce specific recommendedActions.
Non-blocking findings do not cause misleading overall unhealthy copy when all rebuildable state is otherwise valid.
closedReason: Implementation accepted: sync status, sync refresh, prime input, and doctor now expose policy-aware Git findings with targeted actions.
